source_name: LinkedIn — Ukrainian Interbank Payment Systems Member Association "EMA" (ЄМА)
why_relevant: Payments-industry association whose page and event posts tag member-bank payment executives by name and role — an efficient way to snowball an up-to-date actor map of who runs cards/payments at each bank.

source_name: Facebook page — Ukrainian Interbank Payment Systems Member Association "EMA"
why_relevant: In Ukraine the association's Facebook page is more active than its LinkedIn page; event photo albums and speaker announcements identify current payment/security leads at member banks (i.e. 'team photos' weak signal).

source_name: Facebook page — Національна асоціація банків України (НАБУ)
why_relevant: Banking association page; committee/working-group posts name the bank executives who chair them, revealing who currently owns retail, payments, compliance functions at member banks.

source_name: Facebook page — Асоціація українських банків (АУБ)
why_relevant: Second banking association; posts congratulate newly appointed bank chairs and note member-bank management changes, functioning as a de-facto personnel newswire for smaller banks.

source_name: Facebook page — Фінансовий клуб (FinClub)
why_relevant: FinClub is the single most consistent publisher of Ukrainian bank management-board appointments and dismissals; its Facebook feed is where the finance community discusses them in comments, often adding context the article omits (who is really leaving and why).

source_name: Telegram — НБУ | Знати. Розуміти (@nbu_ua)
why_relevant: Regulator's own Telegram channel; publishes NBU leadership appointments and approvals of bank management, and is the reference point community channels react to. The /s/ web view is publicly readable without a Telegram account.

source_name: Telegram — FinTech Ukraine (@uafic, Ukrainian Association of Fintech and Innovation Companies)
why_relevant: Fintech association channel; announces member-company leadership, new teams, hiring and event speakers — captures payments-side people moves that bank-focused media ignore.

source_name: Telegram — Bankova Mail (@bankovamail)
why_relevant: Political-insider channel that frequently trails appointments to state-owned banks (Oschadbank, PrivatBank, Ukrgasbank) and the NBU before formal announcement. Unattributed, so treat as hypothesis-generating only.

source_name: Мінфін (minfin.com.ua) — FinAwards ranking of Ukrainian finance influencers, YouTube and Telegram channels
why_relevant: Annually enumerates the most-followed Ukrainian finance Telegram channels and personal influencers — the fastest way to expand the weak-signal channel list without guessing handles. Rerun each year for the refreshed list.

source_name: InVenture — «10 корисних Telegram-каналів про бізнес, фінанси та інвестиції»
why_relevant: Second independent channel directory; overlaps only partially with the Minfin list, so it widens handle discovery for finance/investment channels where banker moves get discussed.

source_name: Facebook page — Finance.ua
why_relevant: Mass-market finance portal feed; the comment threads under bank-management stories are a community layer where practitioners identify who actually moved where.

source_name: Facebook group — Бізнес спільнота України
why_relevant: General Ukrainian business group where finance professionals post role changes and recruit; a lower-signal but open venue for spotting mid-level banking/payments moves and vacancies.

source_name: psm7.com (PaySpace Magazine) — fintech/payments trade media with executive interviews
why_relevant: Interviews name and title the people currently running payments at the NBU and market players, which lets social weak signals be attributed to a verified role. Also a pointer to the individuals' own social accounts.

source_name: Banker.ua — fintech/banking landing and people news
why_relevant: Ukrainian banking trade outlet that republishes bank personnel announcements and executive commentary; useful for validating and dating social-media claims.

source_name: LinkedIn post permalinks as evidence artefacts (activity URLs)
why_relevant: Concrete demonstration that individual LinkedIn activity URLs are search-indexed and citable: this one identifies a named Deputy Chair of the Management Board / CIO of Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine. Such permalinks are the atomic evidence unit for this cell.

source_name: X (Twitter) — Ukrainian banking/payments accounts
why_relevant: X is a minor channel for Ukrainian banking personnel news (the community sits on Telegram/Facebook/LinkedIn), but English-language posts by international-facing bankers and NBU officials occasionally appear there first for foreign audiences.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — Конференції (Payments & Security EMA Conference archive)
why_relevant: EMA (Українська міжбанківська асоціація членів платіжних систем) has run the Payments & Security conference for 26 consecutive editions; the conferences index lists every event 2001-2026 with per-event pages. Per-event agendas carry speaker names plus employer and job title, dated to the event, across banks, PSPs, vendors and the regulator — bulk title-change detection for the UA payments actor set.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — новини заходів (post-event write-ups)
why_relevant: Post-event news items name panellists and their current positions and often report association board/committee changes — a secondary, prose-form confirmation of the roster data, and a pointer to newly-promoted executives introduced at the event.

source_name: FinAwards (Мінфін / Finance.ua) — офіційний сайт премії
why_relevant: The main annual Ukrainian financial-market award, 8+ editions, 40+ nominations across banks, MFOs and fintechs, including a 'Банкір року' (Banker of the Year) nomination. The jury is explicitly composed of 40+ market experts including the chairs of the boards of the 17 largest banks — i.e. a dated, self-declared list of who currently holds the top job at each bank, published once a year.

source_name: Finance.ua — FinAwards / фінринок nominee and jury coverage
why_relevant: Second FinAwards co-organiser; publishes parallel nominee/jury/voting coverage and its own editorial staff sit on the jury. Useful cross-check when Minfin articles are paywalled or partial.

source_name: Українська асоціація фінтех та інноваційних компаній (UAFIC) — fintechua.org events hub
why_relevant: The Ukrainian fintech association runs the country's main fintech event series — Pay.Forum, Digital Lending, Ukraine Fintech Week, UAFIN.TECH. Each event site publishes a speaker grid with photo, full name, employer and job title, plus a partner/sponsor list that doubles as a vendor actor map. Single hub pointing to many sub-domains.

source_name: UAFIN.TECH — annual fintech conference speaker roster
why_relevant: Seventh-edition annual conference bringing together bank top managers, regulators and fintech leaders; speaker listings observed to carry employer+role (e.g. Mastercard, iPay.ua director of innovations, Activitis CEO, World Bank consultant). A compact, dated cross-section of who currently speaks for which institution.

source_name: Pay.Forum (UAFIC) — payments conference
why_relevant: Dedicated payments conference gathering bank top managers, payment providers, retailers and fintech founders. Highest topical fit for the payments half of the sector scope; speaker/agenda pages are the actor map for UA payments.

source_name: Digital Lending Conference (UAFIC)
why_relevant: Lending/consumer-credit vertical event; speaker roster skews to MFO and bank retail-lending heads — a segment under-covered by the big banking forums, and a place where new heads of retail/risk first appear publicly.

source_name: FinRetail conference
why_relevant: Annual Kyiv conference joining finance, retail, e-commerce and fintech (2026 edition 16 September); explicitly programmes a labour-market ('ринок праці') track alongside company-scaling — directly on-topic for hiring and organisation-change signals, in addition to its speaker roster.

source_name: Національна/Незалежна Асоціація Банків України (NABU) — Fintech & Payments Forum + календар заходів
why_relevant: The banking association's event calendar aggregates its own forums (Fintech & Payments Forum 2026, VI Міжнародний форум корпоративних директорів) and points to member-bank events. The corporate-directors forum in particular surfaces supervisory-board and NED appointments — organisation-change signal not visible in ordinary press.

source_name: NABU Центр навчання (banking association training centre)
why_relevant: The association's professional-education arm: course catalogue and trainer roster. Trainers are named practising bankers with titles, and the course mix (compliance, AML, risk, cards) is a leading indicator of where banks are building teams — i.e. a proxy for hiring direction.
